title: hieracium saxatile subsp. coriifolium
intro: Hieracium saxatile subsp. coriifolium, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). As a medicinal plant, it has been used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
